verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API, and the official MCP server calls it, but no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. A probe of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on the docs site returned 404 on every one. The llms.txt file is documentation for LLMs, not an API spec, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
